title: Goat Cheese and Dill Dutch Baby with Watercress
changes_from_base: Savoury: dill goes into the batter, lemon-zested goat cheese marinated with olive oil and dill is spooned into the centre before baking, and the top is piled with watercress, more cheese, honey and olive oil.
summary: A herb-infused Dutch pancake topped with pockets of creamy marinated goat cheese, fresh greens and a honey drizzle.
equipment: 30 cm cast-iron or ovenproof frying pan

ingredients.item: fresh dill, chopped, plus a few fronds to serve
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Marinate Cheese
steps.text: Mix 148 g crumbled soft goat cheese, 7.5 g chopped fresh dill (half the total) and 1 tbsp oil in a small bowl; zest 1 lemon over, add ⅛ tsp fine salt and a grind of pepper and set aside.

steps.title: Heat Pan
steps.text: Preheat a 30 cm cast-iron or ovenproof frying pan on the lower-third shelf of a 220 °C (200 °C fan) oven.

steps.title: Prepare Batter
steps.text: Whisk 135 g plain flour, ¼ tsp fine salt, ¼ tsp ground black pepper and the remaining 7.5 g chopped dill together in a large bowl.

steps.title: Add Eggs
steps.text: Whisk 8 large eggs and 190 ml whole milk together in a separate medium bowl, then stir this into the flour mixture just until combined.

steps.title: Brown Butter
steps.text: Melt 57 g unsalted butter in the hot pan over medium-high heat for about 5 minutes until nutty and brown, swirling to coat the base and sides; pour in the batter, spoon half the marinated goat cheese into the centre and bake 20-22 minutes until puffed and golden.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Cool in the pan 5-6 minutes, then top with 60 g watercress (or baby spinach or rocket), the remaining cheese, dill fronds, a drizzle of 1 tbsp oil and 1 tbsp runny honey; serve with lemon wedges squeezed over the greens.

tips: Marinate the goat cheese ahead of time to allow flavours to develop fully
Ensure the butter is nutty and brown for a richer, more complex flavour
Add the fresh greens just before serving so they stay crisp and bright
storage: Serve warm. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
